author: TeIq
content: Implemented. Migration 40 adds subject_routing table with active/cleared CHECK constraint. POST /api/cases/{id}/divert (idempotent UPSERT on subject) + DELETE (idempotent clear) + GET /api/diverted-subjects list endpoint. Cleared rows stay for audit but the partial index skips them on queue selection. 532 lib tests pass; clippy -D warnings clean. Live route smoke-tested via /healthz on rebuilt backend.
